title: RedLab Tester - Métricas de Ancho de Banda

panels.title: Ancho de Banda (Mbps) por Switch / Equipo

targets.query:
from(bucket: "iperf_stats")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "iperf_tcp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "bandwidth_mbps")
  |> yield(name: "bandwidth")

from(bucket: "iperf_stats")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_measurement"] == "iperf_tcp")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r["_field"] == "tcp_retransmits")
  |> yield(name: "retransmits")
